prompts.name: sail
prompts.prompt: Create one original tiny UI tab decoration, isolated with true transparent background. A single sculptural object, close-up filling 85% of a square composition. Sophisticated lightweight satin material, softly translucent edges, restrained powder-blue, periwinkle and cobalt iridescence, no chrome, no neon glow, no text, no logo, no border, no badge, no UI. Designed to peek from the right edge of a 44px dark pill navigation tab and remain recognizable at 48px. Soft studio lighting, clean silhouette, premium consumer creative app aesthetic. Subject: an asymmetric folded ribbon sail, flowing upward, cyan tips and deep cobalt fold.
